headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for Daybreak Red customers
quote: achieving a score of 48.5% on the ExploitGym benchmark, compared with 32.1% for its predecessor
claim: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber scores 48.5% on ExploitGym versus 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber, per Cyber Magazine's report on the 5 Nov launch; figures are OpenAI-reported.
why_it_matters: Shows how fast AI exploit-finding is improving; security tooling and bug-bounty work will change, though access is restricted to approved customers.
title: GPT-6 Cyber: OpenAI’s Frontier of “Aligned” Security Agents | Cyber Magazine

headline: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights on Hugging Face
quote: The model card lists 2.8T total parameters, 104B activated, and a context length of 1,048,576 tokens.
claim: Moonshot AI released the Kimi K3.1 Pro weights on Hugging Face on 4 November; the model card lists 2.8T total and 104B activated parameters.
why_it_matters: A near-frontier open-weight model, though at roughly 1.56 TB it needs a multi-GPU server; hosted API is the realistic route for students.
title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Weights Out; Leads Opus 5.5 on 16 of 37 Tests - FourWeekMBA

headline: OpenAI ships Images 2.6 with GIFs and Flare and Sunburst API models
quote: OpenAI says Images 2.6 generates images 50% faster than its predecessor.
claim: OpenAI released Images 2.6, which it says generates images 50% faster than its predecessor, with API models GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst priced at $8 per million image input tokens and $30 per million output tokens.
why_it_matters: Cheaper, faster image generation in the API and free-tier ChatGPT is handy for app prototypes and demos.
title: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 so you can turn AI prompts into GIFs | YourStory

headline: Meta adds Spaces to its Muse agent
quote: Spaces are basically breakout conversations that revolve around a particular topic
claim: Meta launched Spaces for its Muse agent: topic-based conversations in the sidebar that build trackers, planners or project boards and connect to third-party apps. It followed Muse Voice, announced the day before.
why_it_matters: Shows where consumer agents are heading: persistent project workspaces connected to apps, a pattern worth copying in your own agent projects.
title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent | Winzheng
